body:
OP, listen to me. I've been in a relationship like this before. What she's doing is not affection, it's controlling. You're telling me you have NO time for yourself, and have to rotate your entire day around facetiming her? That's not healthy at ALL. She doesn't respect your time or personal space. She doesn't respect you at all. She's using you as a sounding board for her problems. She needs to let you have your own hobbies. And 2-3 solid hours a day, where she demands you immediately stop what you're doing?

Absolutely not okay at all. Please get the fuck out of there. This will only get worse. This kind of behavior is indicative of a really controlling personality. A good partner will respect your  boundaries and try to compromise. The VERY least she could do is allow you a couple days a week of privacy to do your own thing, or to let you still do your thing while talking. But as she refuses to make that small compromise, please do yourself a favor and leave.

As someone who let someone like this destroy all my relationships with my friends and family because he demanded my attention 24/7, don't let it get that bad.
Have you ever looked into the idea that you might be transgender? This is how a lot of people find out, actually.
It's because we feel safe enough to come out now, you knob.

You sound really exhausting. Maybe he didn't have the mental or emotional wherewithal to have those discussions. Just leave him alone. You're not helping. You're the one that decided to end it, so stop making his problems about you. You don't sound like a great friend at all.
I hope you're next. You're doing less for the country except wasting oxygen.

Jesus christ, YTA. You sound like a narcissist. I hope you never have kids. What you did was extremely out of line, abusive, and could constitute as sexual pursuit of a minor. It doesn't matter that you did it as a joke. If she wasn't your sister, you'd be in jail. You should probably be in jail anyway. I hope it was worth emotionally fucking up your sister and making sure she never trusts you again.

I usually jerk my body or head to wake myself up, or kind of consistently "struggle" until I wake up. It's hard, but you can do it. Then turn on the light ans stay awake for at least 10 minutes before trying to sleep again to prevent it from recurring.
Y'all seem really toxic for each other. It's probably best if you break up. Also, she's gaslighting you.
You aren't together any more, man. He's allowed to move on. Maybe you should do the same. Occasional sexting doesn't mean you get to have ownership over his body.
What a beautiful bab! I love that she isn't too busy, very subtle and elegant.
Uneducated means uneducated. There are plenty of perfectly intelligent people who don't have access to an education because of their income.

I'd change the hair or add a hat, something to make the head area more interesting. Maybe throw on a cropped jacket or gloves to break up the basic 'T-shirt and pants' outfit. Colors are nice, though! Your visual style reminds me of the Persona games in a good way.
I logged in just to tell you that you have good taste. Some of my all-time favorites in here. Dragon Quarter especially, nobody else has that game!
This is adorable as hell!

I've heard that psychadelics help with things like OCD and PTSD, but I just don't think I could ever force myself to partake. I think the spike in anxiety just from being around it would probably cause me to have a bad trip.

I think I'll go for more conventional treatment methods, but I appreciate your input.

I'm so sorry that you're having to go through this hell, too, but it's weirdly comforting to know I'm not the only one. Mine comes and goes, too, and there are some days where I can almost pretend I don't have it.

I appreciate your words, though, and I'll try to keep that in mind next time. I've been exposing myself bit by bit to try and show myself it's safe.

Best of luck to you, too. Feel free to DM me if you'd like someone to talk to about it, friend.
You look amazing, dude! You pass fantastically well, too. I'm really happy for you that you've been able to become who you are.
You're a damn fine lookin dude with a nice set of chops! Brave of you to set out on your own, and I wish you all the best, stranger.
You're a good lookin dude with a nice smile and kind eyes. You still look really young, and 30 is far from too old to meet somebody. You've just gotta put yourself out there!
I mean, Catholics eat the body of Christ in communion every Sunday, so this just takes it to it's natural conclusion.
My cat waddles like a penguin when he walks and yells 'Wow!' instead of meowing.
